new.label: Now: plays 40, off the high 30, trend 30

off20.label: Exit rule at 20% off the high

off40.label: Exit rule at 40% off the high

trendx.label: Trend capped at 40 once the price is under its 50-day average

off20x.label: Exit at 20% off the high, trend capped under the 50-day

off3m.label: Exit rule off the 3-month high (15% floor)

halfhalf.label: Half slow, half fast: 1-year and 3-month exits, 200-day and 50-day trends

offvol.label: Exit rule scaled to each stock's volatility

mom121.label: 12-month momentum (skipping the last month) for trend

offrel.label: Exit rule measured against the market's own fall

quality.label: Plus quality: return on equity and debt

sticky.label: A Buy or Sell holds until the score crosses 50

guard.label: Plays alone while the market is 15% or more below its high

guard10.label: Plays alone while the market is 10% or more below its high

guard20.label: Plays alone while the market is 20% or more below its high

guardsticky.label: Market guard and sticky calls together

guardup.label: Market guard plus capped analysts' upside at 15%

relsticky.label: Exit rule against the market, and sticky calls

mktfilter.label: Buy needs 70 while the S&P 500 is below its 200-day
